Installation
============

GitHub install
--------------

The current public install path is directly from the GitHub repository:

.. code-block:: bash

   python -m pip install git+https://github.com/clementlab/MethylSeg.git

Future PyPI release
-------------------

PyPI installation can be documented here once the package is published.

Conda environment
-----------------

This directory also ships with ``environment.yml`` for environment creation in
conda-based workflows used elsewhere in the repository.
